summary: Fix the app icon on non-Retina external displays. (1) icon.icns stored the 1x 16/32 px slots as PNG under icp4/icp5, which macOS decodes as noise; build_icons.py now writes ic04/ic05 ARGB entries (the layout Apple's iconutil produces). (2) The 16/32 px slots used the generic SMALL master (1.4 px bookmark blending to pink, 20% grid margin); they now use hand-tuned paperdig-icon-16/32.svg masters (tighter margin, larger seal, solid wider bookmark, larger eye). Regression test added.

budget_impact.rationale: Static icon asset and its generator script; no gateway operation, prompt, provider call or ceiling touched.
budget_impact.before: icon.icns 1x 16/32 px slots unreadable by macOS; runtime model tokens and USD zero.
budget_impact.after: Classic RLE 1x slots; runtime model tokens and USD remain zero.

checks.note: 882 run, 1 failure: test_i18n missing English entries for strings in app/static/organization.js, which belongs to other uncommitted work in the worktree, not this change. tests/test_app_icon.py (5 tests) passes on its own; evidence file has the details.

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; decoded the old and new icon.icns with iconutil and inspected the 16/32 px slots.

open_risks: After the tuned masters, the ic04/ic05 switch and an icon-cache wipe the external display still shows a small icon with a grey rim; the owner's screenshot shows many other apps rendered the same way, so it is treated as macOS-wide behaviour and the owner chose to stop. Root cause not established by the agent (sandbox cannot render real icons).
Appearance on the owner's external display not verified by the agent; macOS caches app icons, so relaunch or re-copy the app before judging.
Full test suite has one unrelated failure: test_i18n missing English entries for strings in app/static/organization.js.
